We base our translation system on a Transformer encoder-decoder model with the aligned fasttext vectors in its encoder and decoder embedding layers.

We pre-train our machine translation model on a mix of publicly available data in 14 languages: English, Arabic, Bengali, Danish, German, Greek, Spanish, Farsi, French, Hindi, Russian, Tamil, Turkish, Ukranian.
outputs: The paper generates translated text outputs from low-resource languages into English using a pre-trained machine translation model extended with new language embeddings.
